name: Circuit de Spa-Francorchamps

highlights.name: Eau Rouge / Raidillon
highlights.blurb: The corner a 2D map cannot show you. The track drops into a compression at Eau Rouge, then climbs the Raidillon in a blind left-right-left — flat out, uphill, with no sight of the exit.

highlights.name: Les Combes to Stavelot
highlights.blurb: From the high point at Les Combes the circuit gives back everything it climbed — a long, sustained downhill run to the lowest point on the lap.

highlights.name: Raidillon to Les Combes
highlights.blurb: The whole climb, end to end: 65 m of altitude gained between the bottom of Eau Rouge and the crest at Les Combes.

notes: Validated: 107.2 m measured against 102.2 m published (ratio 1.05).
